name: APANA
summary: Volunteer-run community internet network (1992) providing low-cost/non-commercial access; still active as a hobbyist networking org (AUSTRALIAN PUBLIC ACCESS NETWORK ASSOCIATION INC., ACN 081 355 722).

events.details: Founded by Mark Gregson, successor to PubNet; incorporated in Victoria; predates the Wayback archive (earliest apana.org.au capture 12 Jul 1997) and unverified.
